summary: One church, St. Agnes, Sellersville. Both November issues (image-only) print the same schedule box: Sat 5:15 PM vigil, Sun 8/10/12, Mon-Fri 8 AM, Sat 9 AM, Saturday confession; the website matches except Saturday morning confession ending 8:50. Dated: Thanksgiving 9 AM Mass, no Mass Fri Nov 27. Open: the Saturday morning confession end, and placing the 24/7 JPII Adoration Chapel (door code) at the church.

Sanctuary candles which burn in both the Adoration Chapel and in the daily Mass Chapel ... sign-in table in the Adoration Chapel or at the parish office
24/7 Adoration ... The John Paul II Adoration Chapel is always locked for the safety of visitors ... click the button for the door code

slots.rationale: R46/R38: a standing chapel open around the clock, locked at all hours, so access=code. The parish has one church and the chapel is printed in its own schedule box and on its site, but no page gives the chapel's address (POLICY leaves out a chapel whose location is unclear). Leaning per precedent ss-philip-and-james-exton s15 and st-pius-x-broomall s25. Exposition isn't claimed: the site says the Sacrament is behind a curtain outside scheduled-adorer hours.
